name: Mono Changelog
tagline: Black on white, Plex type, one release note at a time.
description: Calm, precise style for release notes and product changelogs. A version tag, a plain title, and list items that fade up one by one with their issue numbers, ending on a blinking caret call to action.

mono.usage: Version tag, dates, kinds and issue numbers 24–30px

textAnimations: rule lines fading in with their item

rhythm.notes: Give each item half a second alone before the next one appears.

guide:
- Only black, white and two grays. No color accents, no shadows, no rounded shapes except the 8px version tag.
- Layout: version tag (mono, outlined) → title → mono date → list with 2px #e5e5e5 rules.
- Each item: uppercase mono kind (NEW / FIXED / IMPROVED), a short benefit-first sentence, and the issue/PR number right-aligned.
- Items fade up (y 30, 0.5s power2.out) 0.55s apart. Max 4 items per scene.
- End card: one short imperative line with a blinking caret, and the changelog URL in mono gray.
